description: Reorder, rotate, or drop PDF pages. Each entry names a 1-based source page and a rotation of 0, 90, 180, or 270. The same page may be listed twice. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused.

data.description: PDF bytes as base64 or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB. Provide data or url.

source.description: 1-based page in the original PDF. The same page may appear more than once.

url.description: Public URL of a PDF. Private and local addresses are refused. Provide data or url.

name: organize_pdf
title: Organize PDF pages
